Method

The 14 days, day by day

The time constraint is not a problem: it forces the right decisions.

  • Day 1

    Alignment call · 30 minutes

    I ask my three key questions: who is your ideal client, what is the single action you want them to take, what is your measurable goal in 3 months. We define the scope together. That's it.

  • Days 2–3

    Architecture & wireframe

    I prepare the site structure: technical choices, architecture, wireframe. You validate before a single line of code is written.

  • Days 4–10

    Development

    Symfony / React as needed. Clean, maintainable code, not throwaway. 17 years of experience applied to every technical decision.

  • Days 11–12

    Content integration

    You send me texts, images, information. I assemble the final site with your real content, no lorem ipsum.

  • Day 13

    Tests & adjustments

    Responsive, performance, security. We fix what needs fixing. The site doesn't go live until it's clean.

  • Day 14

    Go live

    Domain configured, SSL activated, hosting operational. Your site is live. The source code is handed over to you. Mission complete.

Common questions

What people ask me

What's included in the €4,000?

The complete site: design, Symfony/React development, content integration, testing, go-live, domain and SSL configuration, and the source code. No monthly hosting fee charged on top: you choose your hosting provider, I configure everything.

What if my project goes beyond the initial scope?

That's what day 1 is for. We define the scope together before I start. Once the scope is agreed, the price is set. If you want to add features after delivery, we can discuss it. That's a new engagement.

Do you really deliver in 14 days?

Yes. It's contractual. I stopped billing by the day precisely to make delivery predictable. The time constraint forces the right decisions: we prioritise what matters, we don't chase perfection. Something that works live is worth infinitely more than something perfect in a file.

What happens after delivery?

You own the code. You can hand it to any developer for future work: the code is clean and documented. If you want me to continue working on it, we can agree on a maintenance retainer. But I don't create dependency: my goal is that you don't need me afterwards.

What is the "free diagnostic"?

A 30-minute call to check that my format fits your need. I ask my questions, you walk me through your project. At the end, I tell you clearly whether I can deliver what you need in 14 days for €4,000. No commitment.
